name: ExpoPlatform
description_en:
ExpoPlatform focuses on exhibitions and business-event connections. Alongside registration, sites and apps, it offers meeting formats such as self-requested meetings, speed networking, concierge scheduling, hosted-buyer programmes and round tables. Lead retrieval and exhibitor dashboards support the commercial work around those meetings.

A year-round 365 Community is a different operating programme from one event. The pricing page separates a limited free networking offer from custom enterprise events and community packages. Match recommendations and scheduled meetings are not evidence that qualified sales opportunities or revenue will result.
description_zh:
ExpoPlatform 侧重展览与商业活动连接，在报名、网站和应用之外提供自主预约、快速交流、人工协调预约、买家计划及圆桌等会面形式，线索收集和展商报表支持相关商业工作。

全年 365 Community 与单场活动是不同运营项目。定价页把有限免费交流方案与企业活动、社区定制组合区分。推荐匹配或预约会面不能证明会产生合格商机或收入。

core_features.explanation_en: Support requested, scheduled, hosted-buyer and round-table interactions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 支持自主申请、预约、买家计划及圆桌互动。

core_features.explanation_en: Scan and categorize leads, with exhibitor-facing analytics.
core_features.explanation_zh: 扫描并分类线索，提供展商分析。

en: Coordinate hosted-buyer meetings and qualified exhibitor lead handoffs.
zh: 协调买家预约会面与展商线索交接。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Define matching eligibility and quotas, then test a request, reschedule, attendance and lead export with the intended roles.
steps.zh: 定义配对资格及额度，再按预期角色测试申请、改时、出席和线索导出。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Core platform plus exhibitor/attendee scale, modules and services; limited free networking offer.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free networking is bounded to thirty participants and listed formats. Enterprise events and 365 Community are custom quotes based on core platform, exhibitors/attendees, modules and support. No standard enterprise amount verified; developer accounts, custom integrations and onsite services require scope confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 免费交流限 30 人及所列形式，企业活动和 365 Community 按平台、展商/参与者、模块及支持询价。未确定标准企业金额，开发者账户、定制集成与现场服务需明确范围。

sources.title: Event Management Platform: AI-Powered Trade Show Solutions by ExpoPlatform
sources.research_notes_en: Trade-show platform prioritizes meeting formats, matchmaking, exhibitor leads and year-round communities; vendor lead/ROI numbers not adopted.

sources.title: How Much Can Your Event Earn? Use the ExpoPlatform Revenue Calculator
sources.research_notes_en: Core platform plus exhibitor/attendee counts; bounded free networking up to thirty participants distinct from custom Enterprise and Community.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Define the meeting rules before the matching model
sections.title_zh: 先定义会面规则，再考虑匹配模型
sections.en: For an illustrative hosted-buyer show, define eligible buyers/exhibitors, meeting lengths, locations, quotas and who can request or confirm meetings. The platform describes several formats rather than one universal matchmaking flow. Test a declined request, a changed time and a no-show; a recommended pair is not a confirmed meeting, and a confirmed meeting is not attendance.
sections.zh: 例如买家展，应先定义买家/展商资格、时长、地点、额度及谁可申请确认。平台提供多种形式，而不是统一配对流程。应测试拒绝、改时及未出席；推荐配对不是已确认会面，确认也不是实际出席。

sections.title_en: Keep lead collection and sponsor evidence distinct
sections.title_zh: 区分线索收集与赞助效果证据
sections.en: The event app can scan visitor/product QR codes and let exhibitors rate or categorize leads. Verify exhibitor access, consent and export fields before using records in a CRM. Vendor percentage lifts and ROI statements are not independent benchmarks. The 365 package adds ongoing content, groups and marketplace activity; running it needs continuing moderation and data ownership, not only an event-day launch.
sections.zh: 活动应用可扫描访客/产品二维码，让展商评分分类。进入 CRM 前需确认展商访问、同意和导出字段。厂商提升比例及 ROI 不是独立基准。365 组合增加持续内容、分组和市场活动，需要长期管理与数据责任，而不只是活动日上线。

sections.title_en: Use the free networking scope correctly
sections.title_zh: 正确理解免费交流范围
sections.en: The pricing page’s $0 networking offer lists up to thirty participants, unlimited sessions and specified meeting formats. It is not a free full exhibition deployment. Enterprise and 365 Community are quoted from core-platform cost, exhibitor/attendee counts, modules and support. Enterprise describes app hosting on the client’s developer accounts; custom integrations, floorplans, hosted-buyer tools, exhibitor manual and onsite support appear as additions. Confirm all entitlements in the proposal.
sections.zh: 价格页 $0 交流方案限最多 30 人，列不限场次及具体会面形式，不是完整展览免费部署。Enterprise 和 365 Community 按核心平台、展商/参与者数、模块及支持询价。企业应用描述使用客户开发者账户托管，定制集成、平面图、买家工具、展商手册及现场支持另列。应在提案确认全部权益。

sections.title_en: Evaluate the operational programme and its limits
sections.title_zh: 评估实际运营项目与边界
sections.en: ExpoPlatform is a candidate when exhibitor/buyer meetings and lead operations are central. A straightforward ticket-only event may need a narrower tool. Pilot one meeting and one lead through requests, attendance and export before scale. No app, matching model, scan, export or community workflow was tested. Source license, self-hosting, data location, retention and recovery commitments remain unverified.
sections.zh: 展商/买家会面与线索运营是核心时，可以研究 ExpoPlatform；单纯售票可能只需较窄工具。扩大前先试验一条会面与线索，贯穿申请、出席和导出。本文未测试应用、匹配模型、扫描、导出或社区流程，源码许可、自托管、数据位置、保留和恢复未核实。

research_gaps: No meeting, matchmaking quality, app, QR lead, exhibitor export or 365 community was tested.
Free-plan entitlement, paid quote, client developer-account requirements, add-ons, consent, data terms, source license and self-hosting require confirmation.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
